newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus stock erases gains, turns down.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus stock erases gains, turns down.

text.p: Shares in Canal Plus gave up their early gains and were trading down nearly one percent after Finance Director Laurent Perpere told analysts the group expected to break even in 1997, excluding exceptional items.
Prior to Canal Plus's announcement on Friday of plans to merge with Nethold, analysts were expecting a profit for 1997 of between 700 million and 800 million francs.
The share, which hit an early high of 1,190 francs on the merger plan, was down 0.86 percent at 1,159 francs.
Perpere also said there would be a mild dilution in earnings per share until the year 2000 as a result of the merger.
